title: Someone Opened a CashApp In Her Name. She Faces Years in Prison
excerpt: Amanda Smith is charged with computer fraud due to a scam CashApp account being in her name. But in a Kafkaesque situation, CashApp won't provide her any information because she can't prove she is the owner.
